outcome_evidence: The oven door is open at frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot approaches the door, then raises it toward the oven during frames 59–73. By frames 74–81, the door is upright against the oven front; it remains closed as the gripper withdraws through frame 101 in image and left_ego_image, with wrist_image also showing the closed door beside the retreating gripper. No failed attempt or unintended object displacement is visibly established.
